text: Creating a customer record ahead of time makes them searchable, useful for uploading an exemption certificate before first billing
quote: creating it ahead of time makes the customer searchable by name in Anrok - for example, when uploading a tax exemption certificate before the customer's first billing

text: REST API endpoints to retrieve a customer by ID and list all customers on the seller account
quote: Retrieves a customer by its ID.

text: Exemption/resale certificates can be uploaded via the UI or via API, and are collected, verified, and stored
quote: Certificates can be uploaded to Anrok via the Anrok UI as well as via the API.

text: createEphemeral endpoint estimates tax in real time and can be refreshed as transaction details change
quote: This tax amount can be estimated using Anrok's createEphemeral endpoint and should be refreshed any time the customer changes something

text: Tax calculation endpoint saves the transaction and links it to the appropriate tax return for filing
quote: this endpoint also saves the transaction in Anrok and associates it with the appropriate tax return

text: A void operation cancels a transaction or invoice when payment fails or the invoice is canceled
quote: Void can be used in cases where a customer transaction payment was unsuccessful or when the invoice needs to be canceled

text: Refunds are handled via API by creating a negative transaction, or negating and re-creating a transaction for partial refunds
quote: Use createOrUpdate endpoint to create a negative transaction representing the refund.

text: Anrok returns which customer tax IDs to collect and provides valid tax ID formats per jurisdiction
quote: Anrok responds with the list of customer tax IDs to collect... Anrok provides a list of valid tax IDs for each applicable jurisdiction.

text: An address resolution endpoint normalizes customer addresses and determines taxable jurisdictions for accurate tax calculation
quote: The Anrok Address Resolution endpoint resolves a customer address to its normalized form, suitable for sales tax calculations, as well as taxable jurisdiction(s).

text: An API endpoint lets you fetch filings from Anrok
quote: This endpoint can be used to fetch filings from Anrok.

text: API supports many-to-one mapping of your billing system's products to existing Anrok product tax categories
quote: you can use this API endpoint to create many-to-1 mappings to associate various products in your billing system with equivalent products that have already been created in Anrok

text: Sellers only need to set up one product ID per unique tax category rather than per catalog item
quote: Anrok sellers only need to create product IDs for each unique tax category, not every single product in the catalog.

text: Built-in AI answers sales tax questions with visible reasoning, grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates
quote: Ask it anything about your sales tax and get an answer with the reasoning shown, grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates.

text: Tax logic can be driven through APIs directly or handed off to autonomous agents, all backed by one engine
quote: Run tax through Anrok's APIs, or hand it to your agents. One engine powers all five jobs

text: Dashboard visualizes global sales exposure on a world map and tracks progress toward a UK registration threshold
quote: Dashboard showing a world exposure map with sales data by jurisdiction and a UK registration threshold tracker.

text: Dashboard shows tax obligations across many countries and can complete registrations automatically in multiple jurisdictions
quote: Two dashboard screens showing tax obligations in 13 countries and automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions.

text: Integrates with Shopify, recalculating and verifying Shopify's own tax calculations for accuracy
quote: Tax calculation through Shopify requires Shopify tax. Anrok recalculates and verifies Shopify's calculations to ensure accuracy.

text: Provides early alerts before a business incurs tax liability in a new jurisdiction
quote: Early alerts before you owe anywhere
